# Ece Berrak

> Ece Berrak is a T-shaped GTM (go-to-market) generalist based in Berlin. Her depth is user communication: support questions, onboarding, in-product messaging, lifecycle email, engagement and retention. Her breadth covers the full funnel: positioning, brand, content, SEO and AEO, website, campaigns, events, outbound and sales enablement. Product thinking is the root of how she works: start with the problem the user came with, then carry the answer across every channel.

## Experience

- **Nautilida** (2025 to 2026), co-founder and CEO, Berlin. Her own company: an AI-native sales platform. Built brand, positioning, the website, a sales enablement kit and outbound from scratch, worked on product features and the prompt framework, secured a design partner and LOIs.
- **Dataiku** (2024 to 2025), Growth Marketing, Berlin. Owned user communication for an AI and analytics platform: lifecycle email in HubSpot and in-product messaging for two segments (newly onboarded users and advanced champions), engagement, adoption and retention, and answering user questions directly.
- **CRS Soft** (2022), Creative Marketing, Istanbul. UX, SEO and content for B2B software, plus employer branding.
- **Plandy** (2020 to 2022), Affiliate and Partnerships, remote. Built a creator affiliate network from scratch.
- **Community Bilgi** (2019 to 2022), Marketing Content Manager, Istanbul.

## Education

- M.A. Political Economy, HWR Berlin (2023 to 2025). Thesis on digitalization in retail chains and the labor market, USA vs Germany.
- B.A. International Relations and PR, Istanbul Bilgi University (2019 to 2023), marketing minor.
- Associate degree in Social Media Management, Anadolu University (2020 to 2022).

## How she works

Listen to users (support threads, onboarding calls, events, in-product signals), shape the answer like a product person, then carry it through the funnel: lifecycle, content, web, campaigns and sales material.

## Tools

HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Apollo.io, Clay, Instantly, Semrush, Google Analytics 4, Search Console, Google Ads, Figma, Canva, Webflow, Framer, WordPress, HTML/CSS/JS, n8n, Zapier, Apps Script, Notion, Airtable, Claude and Claude Code.
